column1: # Evidence signatures. An instrument counts as USED only when one of these matches.
# tier 1 tool_output        literal native output a real run emits. A lane cannot write
#                           "[Worker 3] New coverage: 4189 instr" without running echidna.
# tier 2 artifact_footprint files or directories only a real run creates.
# tier 3 action_log         a structured action-log record carrying BOTH a command and an
#                           exit code. Lane-attested, so it is the weakest tier and is
#                           labeled as such in every report.
# There is deliberately NO tier that matches a bare tool name in prose. That is structural,
# not a blocklist: an arsenal list in a dispatch plan contains no tool output, creates no
# corpus directory, and carries no exit code, so it cannot match anything here. The control
# suite pins that property with a fixture that names all three fuzzers and must score MISSED.
# kind: line_regex (file contents) | path_regex (campaign-relative path) | cmd_regex (action-log command)
